recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration align force selection to the United Nations general rules of best value for money; of fairness, integrity and transparency; of effective international competition; and of the interests of the United Nations. They should govern the selection criteria of the force generation manual. Selection of troop-contributing countries should take into account the prior conduct and performance of troops from those countries.
